CheckResults.queryText:
/*********
Table Level:  
MEASURE_PERSON_COMPLETENESS
Determine what #/% of persons have at least one record in the cdmTable
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = OBSERVATION_PERIOD
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.person_id) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.person cdmTable
			LEFT JOIN main.OBSERVATION_PERIOD cdmTable2 
			    ON cdmTable.person_id = cdmTable2.person_id
		WHERE cdmTable2.person_id IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.person cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of persons in the CDM that do not have at least one record in the OBSERVATION_PERIOD table

CheckResults.queryText:
/*********
CDM_TABLE
Verify the table exists.
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PERSON
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        num_violated_rows 
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS num_violated_rows
        FROM main.PERSON cdmTable
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: A yes or no value indicating if PERSON table is present as expected based on the specification.

CheckResults.queryText:
/*********
Table Level:  
MEASURE_OBSERVATION_PERIOD_OVERLAP
Determine what #/% of persons have overlapping or back-to-back observation periods
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = OBSERVATION_PERIOD
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.person_id) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT DISTINCT
			cdmTable.person_id 
		FROM main.observation_period cdmTable
		JOIN main.observation_period cdmTable2 
		    ON cdmTable.person_id = cdmTable2.person_id
		    AND cdmTable.observation_period_id != cdmTable2.observation_period_id
		WHERE (cdmTable.observation_period_start_date <= cdmTable2.observation_period_end_date 
		    AND cdmTable.observation_period_end_date >= cdmTable2.observation_period_start_date)
		    OR (CAST(STRFTIME('%s', DATETIME(cdmTable.observation_period_end_date, 'unixepoch', (1)||' days')) AS REAL) = cdmTable2.observation_period_start_date)
		    OR (CAST(STRFTIME('%s', DATETIME(cdmTable2.observation_period_end_date, 'unixepoch', (1)||' days')) AS REAL) = cdmTable.observation_period_start_date)
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(DISTINCT cdmTable.person_id) AS num_rows
	FROM main.observation_period cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of persons that have overlapping or back-to-back observation periods.

Check that values in fields where isRequired == TRUE are non-null
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = NOTE
cdmFieldName = ENCODING_CONCEPT_ID
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
    FROM (
        /*violatedRowsBegin*/

            cdmTable.* 
        FROM main.NOTE cdmTable
        WHERE cdmTable.ENCODING_CONCEPT_ID IS NULL
        /*violatedRowsEnd*/
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows
    FROM main.NOTE cdmTable

;

Computing number of null values and the proportion to total records per field
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = DEVICE_EXPOSURE
cdmFieldName = PERSON_ID
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			'DEVICE_EXPOSURE.PERSON_ID' AS violating_field, 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.DEVICE_EXPOSURE cdmTable
		WHERE cdmTable.PERSON_ID IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.DEVICE_EXPOSURE cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of records with a NULL value in the PERSON_ID of the DEVICE_EXPOSURE.

Computing number of null values and the proportion to total records per field
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = DOSE_ERA
cdmFieldName = DOSE_ERA_END_DATE
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			'DOSE_ERA.DOSE_ERA_END_DATE' AS violating_field, 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.DOSE_ERA cdmTable
		WHERE cdmTable.DOSE_ERA_END_DATE IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.DOSE_ERA cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of records with a NULL value in the DOSE_ERA_END_DATE of the DOSE_ERA.

get number of events that occur after death event (PLAUSIBLE_DURING_LIFE == Yes)
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmDatabaseSchema = main
cdmTableName = DEVICE_EXPOSURE
cdmFieldName = DEVICE_EXPOSURE_START_DATETIME
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
    FROM
    (
        /*violatedRowsBegin*/
        SELECT 
            'DEVICE_EXPOSURE.DEVICE_EXPOSURE_START_DATETIME' AS violating_field, 
            cdmTable.*
        FROM main.DEVICE_EXPOSURE cdmTable
        JOIN main.death de 
            ON cdmTable.person_id = de.person_id
        WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%s', SUBSTR(CAST(cdmTable.DEVICE_EXPOSURE_START_DATETIME  AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(cdmTable.DEVICE_EXPOSURE_START_DATETIME  AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(cdmTable.DEVICE_EXPOSURE_START_DATETIME  AS TEXT), 7)) AS REAL) > CAST(STRFTIME('%s', DATETIME(CAST(STRFTIME('%s', SUBSTR(CAST(de.death_date  AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(de.death_date  AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(de.death_date  AS TEXT), 7)) AS REAL), 'unixepoch', (60)||' days')) AS REAL)
        /*violatedRowsEnd*/
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
(
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows
    FROM main.DEVICE_EXPOSURE cdmTable
    WHERE person_id IN
        (SELECT 
            person_id 
        FROM main.death)

get number of events that occur after death event (PLAUSIBLE_DURING_LIFE == Yes)
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmDatabaseSchema = main
cdmTableName = PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE
cdmFieldName = PROCEDURE_DATE
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
    FROM
    (
        /*violatedRowsBegin*/
        SELECT 
            'PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.PROCEDURE_DATE' AS violating_field, 
            cdmTable.*
        FROM main.PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE cdmTable
        JOIN main.death de 
            ON cdmTable.person_id = de.person_id
        WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%s', SUBSTR(CAST(cdmTable.PROCEDURE_DATE  AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(cdmTable.PROCEDURE_DATE  AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(cdmTable.PROCEDURE_DATE  AS TEXT), 7)) AS REAL) > CAST(STRFTIME('%s', DATETIME(CAST(STRFTIME('%s', SUBSTR(CAST(de.death_date  AS TEXT), 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(de.death_date  AS TEXT), 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(de.death_date  AS TEXT), 7)) AS REAL), 'unixepoch', (60)||' days')) AS REAL)
        /*violatedRowsEnd*/
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
(
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows
    FROM main.PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE cdmTable
    WHERE person_id IN
        (SELECT 
            person_id 
        FROM main.death)
) denominator
;

FROM

) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(DISTINCT cdmTable.person_id) AS num_rows

--DDL to create dqdashboard_results table.

IF OBJECT_ID('@yourResultsSchema.dqdashboard_results', 'U') IS NOT NULL
	DROP TABLE @yourResultsSchema.dqdashboard_results;

CREATE TABLE @yourResultsSchema.dqdashboard_results
(
  num_violated_rows     BIGINT,
  pct_violated_rows     FLOAT,
  num_denominator_rows  BIGINT,
  execution_time        VARCHAR(255),
  query_text            VARCHAR(8000),
  check_name            VARCHAR(255),
  check_level           VARCHAR(255),
  check_description     VARCHAR(8000),
  cdm_table_name        VARCHAR(255),
  cdm_field_name        VARCHAR(255),
  concept_id            VARCHAR(255),
  unit_concept_id       VARCHAR(255),
  sql_file              VARCHAR(255),
  category              VARCHAR(255),
  subcategory           VARCHAR(255),
  context               VARCHAR(255),
  warning               VARCHAR(255),
  error                 VARCHAR(8000),
  checkid               VARCHAR(1024),
  is_error              INTEGER,
  not_applicable        INTEGER,
  failed                INTEGER,
  passed                INTEGER,
  not_applicable_reason VARCHAR(8000),
  threshold_value       INTEGER,
  notes_value           VARCHAR(8000)
);

  failed                INTEGER,
  passed                INTEGER,

CheckResults.queryText:
/*********
Table Level:  
MEASURE_OBSERVATION_PERIOD_OVERLAP
Determine what #/% of persons have overlapping or back-to-back observation periods
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = OBSERVATION_PERIOD
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.person_id) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT DISTINCT
			cdmTable.person_id 
		FROM main.observation_period cdmTable
		JOIN main.observation_period cdmTable2 
		    ON cdmTable.person_id = cdmTable2.person_id
		    AND cdmTable.observation_period_id != cdmTable2.observation_period_id
		WHERE (cdmTable.observation_period_start_date <= cdmTable2.observation_period_end_date 
		    AND cdmTable.observation_period_end_date >= cdmTable2.observation_period_start_date)
		    OR (CAST(STRFTIME('%s', DATETIME(cdmTable.observation_period_end_date, 'unixepoch', (1)||' days')) AS REAL) = cdmTable2.observation_period_start_date)
		    OR (CAST(STRFTIME('%s', DATETIME(cdmTable2.observation_period_end_date, 'unixepoch', (1)||' days')) AS REAL) = cdmTable.observation_period_start_date)
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(DISTINCT cdmTable.person_id) AS num_rows
	FROM main.observation_period cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of persons that have overlapping or back-to-back observation periods.

CDM_FIELD
Verify the field exists.
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PERSON
cdmFieldName = RACE_SOURCE_CONCEPT_ID
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM (
    SELECT num_violated_rows FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(RACE_SOURCE_CONCEPT_ID) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS num_violated_rows
        FROM main.PERSON cdmTable
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: A yes or no value indicating if RACE_SOURCE_CONCEPT_ID is present in the PERSON table as expected based on the specification.

Check that values in fields where isRequired == TRUE are non-null
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = NOTE_NLP
cdmFieldName = LEXICAL_VARIANT
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
    FROM (
        /*violatedRowsBegin*/
        SELECT 
            'NOTE_NLP.LEXICAL_VARIANT' AS violating_field, 
            cdmTable.* 
        FROM main.NOTE_NLP cdmTable
        WHERE cdmTable.LEXICAL_VARIANT IS NULL
        /*violatedRowsEnd*/
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows
    FROM main.NOTE_NLP cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of records with a NULL value in the LEXICAL_VARIANT of the NOTE_NLP that is considered not nullable.

FIELD_CDM_DATATYPE
In some SQL dialects, check that integer fields only contain digits.
In others, check that integer fields are numeric and contain no decimal points
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = OBSERVATION
cdmFieldName = VISIT_DETAIL_ID
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
	denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			'OBSERVATION.VISIT_DETAIL_ID' AS violating_field, 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.OBSERVATION cdmTable
		WHERE 
			(CASE WHEN TRIM(CAST(CAST(cdmTable.VISIT_DETAIL_ID AS numeric) AS char), '0.') = TRIM(CAST(cdmTable.VISIT_DETAIL_ID AS char), '0.') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 0 
			OR (CASE WHEN TRIM(CAST(CAST(cdmTable.VISIT_DETAIL_ID AS numeric) AS char), '0.') = TRIM(CAST(cdmTable.VISIT_DETAIL_ID AS char), '0.') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 
				AND CHARINDEX('.', CAST(ABS(cdmTable.VISIT_DETAIL_ID) AS TEXT)) != 0))
			AND cdmTable.VISIT_DETAIL_ID IS NOT NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.OBSERVATION
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: A yes or no value indicating if the VISIT_DETAIL_ID in the OBSERVATION is the expected data type based on the specification. Only checks integer fields.

CDM_FIELD
Verify the field exists.
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = MEASUREMENT
cdmFieldName = VISIT_DETAIL_ID
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM (
    SELECT num_violated_rows FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(VISIT_DETAIL_ID) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS num_violated_rows
        FROM main.MEASUREMENT cdmTable
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: A yes or no value indicating if VISIT_DETAIL_ID is present in the MEASUREMENT table as expected based on the specification.

CDM_FIELD
Verify the field exists.
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PROVIDER
cdmFieldName = NPI
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM (
    SELECT num_violated_rows FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(NPI) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS num_violated_rows
        FROM main.PROVIDER cdmTable
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: A yes or no value indicating if NPI is present in the PROVIDER table as expected based on the specification.

Verify the field exists.
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = VISIT_DETAIL
cdmFieldName = PERSON_ID
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM (
    SELECT num_violated_rows FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(PERSON_ID) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS num_violated_rows
        FROM main.VISIT_DETAIL cdmTable
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: A yes or no value indicating if PERSON_ID is present in the VISIT_DETAIL table as expected based on the specification.

Computing number of null values and the proportion to total records per field
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD
cdmFieldName = PAYER_CONCEPT_ID
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			'PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD.PAYER_CONCEPT_ID' AS violating_field, 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD cdmTable
		WHERE cdmTable.PAYER_CONCEPT_ID IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.PAYER_PLAN_PERIOD cdmTable
) denominator
;

CheckResults.queryText:
/*********
Table Level:  
MEASURE_CONDITION_ERA_COMPLETENESS
Determine what #/% of persons have condition_era built successfully 
for persons in condition_occurrence table
Parameters used in this template:
cdmTableName = CONDITION_ERA
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.person_id) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT DISTINCT 
		    co.person_id
		FROM main.condition_occurrence co
		LEFT JOIN main.CONDITION_ERA cdmTable 
		    ON co.person_id = cdmTable.person_id
  	    WHERE cdmTable.person_id IS NULL
  	    AND co.condition_concept_id != 0
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS num_rows
	FROM main.condition_occurrence co
    WHERE co.condition_concept_id != 0
) denominator
;

The number and Percent of persons that does not have condition_era built successfully 
for all persons in condition_occurrence

MEASURE_VALUE_COMPLETENESS
Computing number of null values and the proportion to total records per field
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = OBSERVATION
cdmFieldName = UNIT_CONCEPT_ID
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			'OBSERVATION.UNIT_CONCEPT_ID' AS violating_field, 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.OBSERVATION cdmTable
		WHERE cdmTable.UNIT_CONCEPT_ID IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.OBSERVATION cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of records with a NULL value in the UNIT_CONCEPT_ID of the OBSERVATION.

/*********
Table Level:  
MEASURE_CONDITION_ERA_COMPLETENESS
Determine what #/% of persons have condition_era built successfully 
for persons in condition_occurrence table
Parameters used in this template:
cdmTableName = CONDITION_ERA
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.person_id) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT DISTINCT 
		    co.person_id
		FROM main.condition_occurrence co
		LEFT JOIN main.CONDITION_ERA cdmTable 
		    ON co.person_id = cdmTable.person_id
  	    WHERE cdmTable.person_id IS NULL
  	    AND co.condition_concept_id != 0
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS num_rows
	FROM main.condition_occurrence co
    WHERE co.condition_concept_id != 0
) denominator
;

CDM_FIELD
Verify the field exists.
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = OBSERVATION
cdmFieldName = OBSERVATION_CONCEPT_ID
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM (
    SELECT num_violated_rows FROM (
        SELECT
            CASE 
                WHEN COUNT(OBSERVATION_CONCEPT_ID) = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS num_violated_rows
        FROM main.OBSERVATION cdmTable
    ) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
    SELECT 1 AS num_rows
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: A yes or no value indicating if OBSERVATION_CONCEPT_ID is present in the OBSERVATION table as expected based on the specification.

Computing number of null values and the proportion to total records per field
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE
cdmFieldName = MODIFIER_SOURCE_VALUE
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			'PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.MODIFIER_SOURCE_VALUE' AS violating_field, 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE cdmTable
		WHERE cdmTable.MODIFIER_SOURCE_VALUE IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of records with a NULL value in the MODIFIER_SOURCE_VALUE of the PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.

Computing number of null values and the proportion to total records per field
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmTableName = PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE
cdmFieldName = PERSON_ID
**********/
SELECT 
	num_violated_rows, 
	CASE 
		WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
		ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
	END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
	SELECT 
		COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
	FROM
	(
		/*violatedRowsBegin*/
		SELECT 
			'PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.PERSON_ID' AS violating_field, 
			cdmTable.* 
		FROM main.PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE cdmTable
		WHERE cdmTable.PERSON_ID IS NULL
		/*violatedRowsEnd*/
	) violated_rows
) violated_row_count,
( 
	SELECT 
		COUNT(*) AS num_rows
	FROM main.PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE cdmTable
) denominator
;
CheckResults.checkDescription: The number and percent of records with a NULL value in the PERSON_ID of the PROCEDURE_OCCURRENCE.

CheckResults.queryText:
/*********
PLAUSIBLE_AFTER_BIRTH
Checks that all events happen after birth (PLAUSIBLE_AFTER_BIRTH == Yes)
Birthdate is either birth_datetime or composed from year_of_birth, month_of_birth, day_of_birth (taking 1st month/1st day if missing).
Denominator is number of events with a non-null date.
Parameters used in this template:
schema = main
cdmDatabaseSchema = main
cdmTableName = CONDITION_ERA
cdmFieldName = CONDITION_ERA_START_DATE
**********/
SELECT 
    num_violated_rows, 
    CASE 
        WHEN denominator.num_rows = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 1.0*num_violated_rows/denominator.num_rows 
    END AS pct_violated_rows, 
    denominator.num_rows AS num_denominator_rows
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        COUNT(violated_rows.violating_field) AS num_violated_rows
    FROM
    (
        /*violatedRowsBegin*/
        SELECT 
            'CONDITION_ERA.CONDITION_ERA_START_DATE' AS violating_field, 
            cdmTable.*
        FROM main.CONDITION_ERA cdmTable
        JOIN main.person p 
            ON cdmTable.person_id = p.person_id

(
